reelection.rule: Rule: end of the current class term in legislators-current.yaml. Class 1 ends 2031-01-03. The November before that January 3 end is November 2030. The file does not store the election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 Senate votes, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 16. Not Voting: 5. Of 35 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 35 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 44 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

finance.disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
finance.cycle_rule: Senate filings use the two-year cycle of the next election. the current term ends 2031-01-03, so the preceding November election is 2030.
finance.scope_note: Figures are committee receipts and itemized Schedule A for this two-year cycle only. This is not career fundraising. Schedule E outside spending is not included.
finance.error: OpenFEC has no Schedule A data for the 2030 two-year cycle. OpenFEC returned HTTP 404: two_year_transaction_period not found. Data exists for two_year_transaction_periods between 1976 and 2026. No receipts from another cycle are substituted.

lobbying_summary.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.

running.label: Candidates who filed with the FEC for this seat. Filing is not the same as being on the ballot. Primary results and ballot access are not shown.
running.year_rule: Senate filings use the two-year cycle of the next election. the current term ends 2031-01-03, so the preceding November election is 2030.
incumbent_notes: Ruben Gallego has a 2030 filing for this seat (FEC S4AZ00139, FEC lists: Incumbent). Not counted below.

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.
donor_industry.cycle_rule: The current term began 2025-01-03, so the most recent completed election for this seat was in 2024 (FEC two-year cycle 2024).
donor_industry.cycle_note: Fallback cycle: these figures are from the 2024 two-year cycle (most recent completed election), not the current 2030 cycle. The 2030 cycle has no itemized donors yet.

cycle_fields.calendar_period_note: This seat reports toward the 2030 election. Money dated 2025–2026 is filed under the 2026 FEC period and is not shown on this card yet.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: Senate votes 1–262 of the 119th Congress, session 2 (262 votes, January 5, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the Senate LIS.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.
stands_for.factual_flag: Not yet summarized: this line is built only from the official vote question and the bill's official title.

party_line.scope: Senate votes 1–262 of the 119th Congress, session 2 (262 votes, January 5, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the Senate LIS.

topics.rule: nomination (PN) in the Senate vote XML

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
$298 million for Stanley Black & Decker.  
$331 million for TJ Maxx. 
Potentially millions for executive bonuses. 
$0 for you.

This isn’t over. I’ll keep fighting back. https://t.co/NgVxyPtWRZ
Democrats need to seize the opportunity to fix our broken immigration system. https://t.co/PLabanDpwj
We need to know if Elon Musk is a threat to our national security. I’m going to get answers. https://t.co/Nxn2RLmxBQ
Apparently “I had no idea she was a spy” is supposed to settle it? Congress, the public, and Nvidia shareholders deserve a little more than that. https://t.co/nEAxyyoHMH
Hell of a career, Brahm. You’ve set the standard for Arizona journalism with tough, fair reporting. Congratulations on a well-deserved retirement. https://t.co/b6So4QxEgR
It's time to figure out how to keep families together, attract innovators from around the world, and ensure the American Dream is achievable for everyone. https://t.co/IOm0x9P4qP
Right now, Latinos are giving Democrats the chance to earn their vote again. And that has to start with us delivering on immigration reform to protect our families. https://t.co/pJ19iVRZ49

Happy Veterans Day! 

To everyone who has ever worn the uniform: thank you for your service and sacrifice. And to my Lima 3/25 brothers: Semper Fi. https://t.co/RonD2xKtVa

I’ve got a bill to increase the minimum wage to $20/hr and peg it to inflation so it doesn’t fall behind again. 

When Democrats finally take back power, the American people expect us to wield it. 

So, let’s wield it. https://t.co/7fa6T0fLnv
Democrats won the majority. Now we need to work on what people actually care about: ending this stupid war, rolling back Trump’s tariffs, lowering costs, and cleaning up corruption in Washington.
More: https://t.co/nMIE2Cop6Q

We just secured $9.6 million to help eliminate dangerous railroad crossings, cut traffic delays, and keep people and goods moving across Arizona. Proud to get this funding over the finish line. https://t.co/XutQP17VBR
Beautiful night celebrating Diwali with the Indo-American Cultural and Religious Foundation of Arizona! https://t.co/K0EDoB2ewW
More: https://t.co/FLxYM1Jrut

Billionaires borrow against their wealth TAX-FREE to pay for their lifestyle. Meanwhile, you’re paying taxes on every paycheck. I’ve got a bill to close that loophole and make billionaires pay their fair share. https://t.co/8PG9pKxhzi

I thought of my friend, Dolores Huerta, this week in Yuma. There, farmworkers grow 90% of America's winter lettuce. Because of her, the men and women who wake up at 2 a.m. to pick our food by hand have better pay and more opportunities. 

It's on us to carry her legacy forward. https://t.co/Pa25zL7GEI
This is the most unprofessional BS. Pete Hegseth literally just double downed and asked for an impeachment. https://t.co/tqPHKqDJJG

Elon Musk has Ukrainian blood on his hands. He needs to come in and explain what the hell happened when he altered a global conflict with the flick of a switch. 

See you in January, @elonmusk. https://t.co/YBnZAAePH6

Pete Hegseth is waging war while keeping Congress in the dark.

The American people deserve answers about what's happening, what the objectives are, and how this war ends.

This isn't a partisan game. It's about accountability. https://t.co/osIbPrmBWD
My office is monitoring the flooding impacting our communities closely. If you're in an affected area, please follow evacuation orders. Stay safe, Arizona. https://t.co/ukmlrax45E

Trump’s FTC is probing corporations like Walmart, DoorDash, and JetBlue over how they use your data to charge you more, but not Amazon. 

Amazon is also one of Trump’s White House ballroom donors.

We need to investigate every company engaged in surveillance pricing. Then we need to pass my bill to ban it.

Casa Grande raised @jesusramosjr_ . They’ve had his back from the start, and now he has a championship belt to show for it.

Good to meet him at Ramos Boxing Academy and hear how he is giving back to his community. https://t.co/aAYBkI7w5k

Sometimes what helps with healing most is a project, the right tools, and people who get it. That’s what Guardian Garage in Peoria, Arizona offers.

While I was there, I sat down with military families and veterans to hear what they’re dealing with, from the cost of living to https://t.co/8dJyTI57DQ

Gas, groceries, energy: it all costs more. Diesel now averages around $6.30 a gallon nationwide.

The most important thing Trump could do right now to bring prices down? End his stupid war in Iran. https://t.co/LWSk5m35Pk

Putin bears the sole responsibility for Russia’s full-scale war of aggression against Ukraine. Because of him, tens of thousands of Ukrainian civilians are dead or injured, including children. 

The only thing Steve Witkoff should be calling Putin is a war criminal and an enemy of the United States.

Big news for Arizona! Chiricahua is now officially America’s 64th national park, and Arizona’s fourth.

If you’ve been, you know: it's called the “Wonderland of Rocks” for a reason. Huge volcanic eruptions and years of erosion left behind thousands of towering rock pinnacles in Cochise County, and the views are like nothing else in the country.

If you haven't been, now is the time to visit Chiricahua National Park!

First, President Trump blocked bipartisan sanctions on Russia. Now he’s refusing to approve interceptor missiles for Ukraine.

Putin is playing Trump like a fiddle. America should be on the side of freedom and democracy, not the authoritarian waging a war of aggression on our ally.

Arizona families work hard for every dollar they earn, but rising gas and grocery prices are eating up their paychecks.

I’m fighting to lower costs, but the fastest way to do that is simple: end the war in Iran. https://t.co/IYuB9gxSj1
Child care should not be a luxury. We need to make high-quality child care as universal as possible so that every parent can afford to work and raise their kids. https://t.co/gwOJICSb1g

Trump is spending billions on an illegal war that nobody asked for. Imagine what that money could do if we funded childcare or healthcare instead. 

End the war in Iran. Invest in working families.

Thank you to the child care leaders, parents, and providers who joined me at my town hall yesterday.

Every story in that room came back to the same two problems: child care costs too much, and there aren’t enough spots for the families who need them. We have to do better for Arizona's kids and families.

On average, Arizona families spend more than $16,000 per year on child care. That’s more than college tuition at ASU. 

I’m backing a bill to cap the price of child care. We’ve got to get serious about making it easier to be a working parent.

Gas: +43.7%
Child care: +7.6% 
Electricity: +12.7%
Groceries: +3.7%
Health care: +14.6% 
Rent: +5.1%

The average American household is paying about $3,388 more thanks to inflation under Trump. https://t.co/2uGov0Anyf

Despicable. 

This soldier joined the Army to support his family and provide legal status for his wife, who was brought here as a kid. Now ICE is trying to deport her.

Our troops put their lives on the line for our country, and Trump is repaying them by ripping their families apart.

Democrats and Republicans passed sanctions to send an unambiguous bipartisan message to Russia: end the war of aggression in Ukraine.

By blocking them, Trump is bankrolling Putin’s illegal war. 

Mr. President, please explain: How does handing our enemy a gift serve our national interests?

Yet another American community is grieving the death of innocent lives after a school shooting.

It’s unconscionable that we live in a country where millions of parents hope their kids come home from school alive.

We have to do more to protect our communities from gun violence. https://t.co/yD6yDtK8xQ

Many Arizona families can’t afford child care. And even when they can, they can’t find a spot.

Join me and child care leaders from across Arizona on Monday, Oct. 19 for a town hall on making child care affordable and easier to find.

RSVP at the link below.
https://t.co/CCVkSsq9Us

No one should be afraid to walk into their place of worship.

We stand with Representative Krishnamoorthi, the people of Aurora, and our Hindu and Indian American communities. Hate and violence of any kind have no place in our country. https://t.co/i1Bbj7qcWr

As union density has gone down, wages have stalled. 

Corporations are making record profits while workers are taking home a smaller slice of the economy than ever before. 

Here’s one way we can rebuild union power and change the direction of the working class. https://t.co/PcbSNj3uRv

For 251 years, the U.S. Navy has defended our seas and guarded our freedom across the globe.  

Here’s to the next 251 years. Semper Fortis! https://t.co/CSIwuubnpZ
In case you missed it, I put out a plan to save the middle class and restore the American dream. https://t.co/C8lzvAYSJO
Arizona wouldn't be the great state it is without our farmers and farmworkers. Happy National Farmers Day! https://t.co/29n80JZfMj

One of the best parts of this job is meeting the next generation of Arizona leaders.

I was honored to speak with students in the Latino Leaders Program at Chandler City Hall. I may be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but if these kids have anything to do with it, I won’t be the last.

It’s Indigenous Peoples’ Day—a day to honor the Indigenous communities that continue to shape Arizona's history, heritage, and culture.

I’m proud to represent Arizona’s 22 sovereign tribal nations in the U.S. Senate. Today and every day, I’m committed to working alongside them to defend their sovereignty.
Es importante que en este país trabajemos y tengamos la oportunidad de lograr el sueño americano. https://t.co/m28dZxOWqt

This is what it looks like when we trust the guys profiting off AI to regulate it themselves.

They’re preparing for the aftermath of a catastrophe, not preventing one. 

We need immediate Congressional oversight to protect humanity. https://t.co/77L8ghpVQT

Trump’s illegal forever war is sending gas prices through the roof.  

His solution? Handing Putin a payday to the tune of billions of dollars as Russia continues to help Iran target our troops. 

My colleagues and I introduced the bipartisan NOPE Act to stop Trump from unilaterally easing Russian sanctions. We need to get it done.

The future of 6G and satellite technology will be decided at next year's World Radiocommunication Conference in China.

The U.S. can't afford to show up without a lead negotiator. I'm urging Secretary Rubio to name one now.

We should be setting the rules, not China. https://t.co/SQfa1eB2BM

BREAKING: After a record-setting 321 days at sea, the USS Abraham Lincoln just arrived home. 

It’s clear this administration looks at our men and women in uniform not as human beings, but as pawns in their political games. The Lincoln's deployment is just the latest example.

I won't let up. Our service members and their families deserve answers.

AI companies are making a fortune right now. Working people can't get left behind. 

My plan is simple: tax AI companies and data centers, then use that money to put Americans to work in a New Deal-style public service jobs program.

We did it before and it helped build this country. We can do it again.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
